gloss: to err; to make a mistake; to misjudge

definitions.gloss: to err; to make a mistake; to be wrong
definitions.explanation: To do something incorrectly or to reach the wrong conclusion. Distinct from {謝|あやま}る (to apologize), which sounds identical but is written with a different kanji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誤|あやま}った。
⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誤|あやま}る⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧なこと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you take the wrong path, things will turn serious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誤|あやま}らないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You should think carefully so as not to make the wrong choice.

notes:
Transitive godan verb ({誤|あやま}る・{誤|あやま}って・{誤|あやま}った). More formal and written than ⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧. The passive form {誤|あやま}られる is uncommon; the participial {誤|あやま}った is frequently used as a modifier ('mistaken X').

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive: marks what is gotten wrong with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.
- ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誤|あやま}る: to misjudge
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誤|あやま}る: to take the wrong path (also figurative: 'go astray')

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誤|あやま}る: to misjudge
- ⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誤|あやま}る: to choose wrongly
- {誤|あやま}った⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: incorrect information
- ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{誤|あやま}る: to use incorrectly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧: to make a mistake — much more common in everyday speech; broader scope
- ⟦{謝|あやま}る→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧: to apologize — same reading, different kanji and meaning
- ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fail — focuses on a failed outcome, not the wrong choice itself
